 Beauty of Joseon owner Goodai Global applies for South Korean IPO 
 Catherine Rowe-Kosary 17 November 2026 
 Twitter 
 Facebook 
 Linkedin 
 WhatsApp 
 South Korean cosmetics company Goodai Global, the owner of skincare brands Beauty of Joseon and SKIN1004, has applied to list on the country's main stock market, the Korea Exchange (KRX) has announced. 
 The company submitted its preliminary application to list on the Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) market on 13 November, according to the exchange.
 Founded in December 2016, Goodai Global is led by founder and Co-Chief Executive Cheun Ju-hyuk, with Cheun and six other shareholders holding a combined 80.54% stake in the business at the time of the filing.
 For 2025, Goodai Global reported revenue of 456.5 billion won (approximately £343 million), operating profit of 139.6 billion won (£105 million) and net profit of 92.3 billion won (£69 million), based on non-consolidated figures. Its total assets stood at 1.39 trillion won (approximately £1.04 billion).
 The proposed li sting comes amid growing international demand for Korean beauty products. T he global K-beauty market is forecast to nearly double from $14.1 billion (£10.7 billion) in 2023 to $28 billion (£21.3 billion) by 2032, according to research by Credence Research, reflecting increasing adoption across markets including Europe and North America.
 Mirae Asset Securities has been appointed lead underwriter for the proposed listing, with NH Investment & Securities acting as co-underwriter.
 The application comes as Beauty of Joseon continues to build its profile in the UK market. The brand has expanded its local activity through experiential pop-ups and collaborations, including a week-long partnership with London matcha café How Matcha! in October .
 Its Relief Sun: Rice + Probiotics SPF50+ also topped Lookfantastic's summer travel beauty rankings in July, recording more than 80,000 product page sessions over 90 days.
 Goodai Global's portfolio also includes SKIN1004, another Korean skincare brand with a growing international presence.
